commit.message:
feat(ship): --check-shipped-head, the read-only half of the coordinator aggregate ship (PR A) (#394)

* feat(ship): ship-commit --check-shipped-head, the grant reader and the archive refusal (PR A of the coordinator aggregate ship)

* fix(ship): PR A audit round 1 - live base by default, fail-closed grant home, dispatcher, markup balance, bounds, sanitized git env

* fix(ship): PR A audit round 2 - one markup rule for both grammars, sanitized worktree discovery

* fix(ship): PR A audit round 3 - one base resolution, comments in document order

* fix(ship): PR A audit round 4 - markup judged in context

* fix(ship): PR A audit round 5 - raw HTML, headings, fenced delimiters

* fix(ship): PR A audit round 6 - plain-log-line whitelist (the pivot), live base re-read, audited-commit binding, heading-aware log end

* docs(plan): PR A code audit trail

* fix(ship): PR A past-cap round - reference definitions inside list containers

* fix(ship): the log-line forbidden set as one named constant (no cross-line Markdown characters)

* fix(ship): PR A final round - strict log-line set (no Markdown characters), one-hyphen setext, legacy reference definitions

* refactor(ship): PR A rework - path-only post-audit delta (added docs/status/entries file only); delete the Markdown content grammar

* fix(ship): PR A rework audit round 1 - branch identity re-check, split import/read errors, isolated fixture git, plan contract aligned

* fix(ship): PR A rework audit round 2 - entry names in the repo's own grammar, worktree path, contract text, fixture cleanup

* fix(ship): PR A rework audit round 3 - the default branch is asked of the remote, not of a possibly stale local symref

* fix(ship): PR A rework audit round 4 - local base snapshot in both modes, default branch re-read

* fix(ship): PR A rework audit round 5 - the base is resolved once to a commit id and passed to both calculations

* fix(ship): PR A rework audit round 6 - JSON envelope on checker errors, repository lookup reason carried

* docs(plan): PR A rework audit trail

* test(ship): the relocated store-off check needs a base (the round-5 base guard refuses first)
